description: This file implements an HTTP client using libcurl, providing methods for GET, POST, DELETE requests, JSON handling, and retry logic. It also includes utility functions for DNS resolution and curl debugging.

classes.name: CurlClient
classes.description: A curl-based implementation of the HttpClient interface, supporting HTTP methods, JSON, file download, and URL resolution.

classes.name: ServerErrorRetryClient
classes.description: A decorator for HttpClient that adds retry logic for server errors.

methods.name: GetToString
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request and returns the response as a string.

methods.name: PostToString
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request with data and returns the response as a string.

methods.name: DeleteToString
methods.description: Performs an HTTP DELETE request and returns the response as a string.

methods.name: PostToJson
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request with JSON data and returns the response as JSON.

methods.name: DownloadToFile
methods.description: Downloads content from a URL and saves it to a specified file path.

methods.name: DownloadToJson
methods.description: Downloads content from a URL and parses it as JSON.

methods.name: UrlEscape
methods.description: Escapes a string for safe inclusion in a URL.
